verdict.rationale: Devin can be driven without a UI: its API is documented for integrating Devin into applications and automating workflows, including creating sessions on behalf of users. Cron and one-time scheduling are available through Devin's MCP server, and Devin Review Auto-Fix iterates on CI failures automatically. The CLI is documented, but the evidence frames it as interactive. Missing for 10: a documented non-interactive/headless CLI mode, explicit recipes for running Devin as a CI pipeline step (e.g. GitHub Actions), a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
